nodes.name: Win Semiconductor
aliases: 穩懋半導體股份有限公司

claims.statement: WIN Semiconductors' own Aug–Sept 2026 deck marks CW-DFB as 'Ongoing Qualification' — not yet 'Mass Production' — on its datacom-to-telecom optical device map (p.23), next to a CW-DFB roadmap from 70 mW to 400 mW (p.24). As a pure-play foundry its CW-DFB customers are not named on these pages (Sivers' outsourcing to WIN is the existing co:win_semiconductor supplies_to co:sivers_semiconductors edge). Issuer self-report (L8): qualification stage only, no volume or customer qualification evidence.
claims.disproof_condition: 條件：到 2027-06-30 為止，穩懋法說簡報仍把 CW-DFB 標為 Ongoing Qualification（沒有進 Mass Production），或不再列 CW-DFB。核查頻率：每季（穩懋法說簡報，MOPS t100sb07_1）。觸發後 48 小時：重跑 python -m query.structure tech:cw_dfb_laser，e1 降 confidence（或改成 develops），並在 CW DFB 層讀圖與 co:sivers_semiconductors 的敘事註記代工端仍未量產。

claims.statement: WIN says it 'is now developing 6-inch InP capability', leveraging its 6-inch GaAs base ('world's largest GaAs 6-inch wafer capacity') with 'Limited capex required (Leveraging existing 6-inch equipments and facilities)' (p.26). If realized it is a second entrant beside Coherent on tech:six_inch_inp_production; today it is development only (issuer self-report, L8).
claims.disproof_condition: 條件：後續簡報或年報不再提 6-inch InP，或改稱以 4 吋 InP 為主；或到 2027-12-31 仍只寫 developing、沒有任何 6 吋 InP 量產或客戶驗證的揭露。核查頻率：每季（穩懋法說簡報）＋每年（年報約 5 月）。觸發後 48 小時：e4 降 confidence 或提撤回，並更新 tech:six_inch_inp_production 層讀圖（目前圖上只有 Coherent）。

claims.statement: The same p.23 map marks EML as 'Ongoing Qualification' at WIN — a potential foundry entrant on tech:eml beside Coherent, Lumentum and the LuxNet pre-ramp line; VCSEL and InP PIC are marked 'Mass Production'. Issuer self-report (L8); no EML customer named.
claims.disproof_condition: 條件：到 2027-06-30 為止，穩懋簡報仍把 EML 標為 Ongoing Qualification，或不再列 EML。核查頻率：每季（穩懋法說簡報）。觸發後 48 小時：e2 降 confidence 或提撤回，更新 tech:eml 層讀圖。
